name: Oil pickup tube and screen
what: The pickup tube draws oil from the sump through a screened inlet.
why: The screen helps keep larger debris from entering the oil pump.
where: It connects to the oil pump and extends down into the oil pan.
installationReason: The pickup tube connects to the oil pump and its screened inlet sits inside the oil pan sump.
